purpose: This table is a reference lookup of airline carriers, mapping IATA carrier codes to full airline names, feeding downstream flight and booking analytics tables that need to resolve or display carrier identity.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column (2-letter IATA code) to enrich other tables with the full airline name in the name column; both columns are fully populated with null_rate 0.0, so no null handling is required for either.
limitations: The profile reflects a single snapshot of 16 rows with 16 distinct carrier codes and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so the uniqueness of carrier as the declared grain is only confirmed at this small scale and should be re-checked as new carriers are onboarded; no data quality issues beyond dropped Airbyte metadata columns were observed.
